text:
Nora: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A 1: procurement status, region quotas, and autoscaler safety nets. Dropping concise answers + next steps here.
Ethan: Short update: SIN procurement delayed by partner paperwork -> swapping one reserved pool to KUL to keep pilot timing. Pilot still targets late-May window.
Lina: Why KUL? Is latency ok for primary APAC customers?
Ethan: KUL chosen based on available stock + lower lead time. Network peering for major customers looks fine; we'll route traffic with locality preference so most traffic stays in-region.
Vikram: Autoscaler notes: v1.2 adds a circuit-breaker for rapid multi-tenant bursts to protect Dedicated pools. If global token rate > threshold we trim burst allocation and surface a warning header to clients.
Nora: How will customers see circuit-breaker events?
Vikram: We'll add header `x-rdi-circuit: active` on affected requests and emit an org-level alert in Console. We'll also log a trace id so support can correlate.
Lina: Data residency question: what's the exact API flag and behavior if capacity is constrained?
Ethan: API route flag `residency_preference: strict|best_effort`. If `strict`, autoscaler queues or returns 429 with header `x-rdi-reason: residency-block`. If `best_effort` (default) it follows fallback ordering.
Vikram: Fallback ordering we agreed: (1) local Reserved, (2) local Burst, (3) regional sibling (e.g., KUL <-> SIN), (4) nearest EU, (5) US-west. We'll publish this in the public FAQ.
Lina: Billing visibility: customers worried about cross-region egress and spot costs.
Ethan: Console change: org-level `allow_cross_region_fallback` toggle (off by default). If enabled we'll show a projected egress estimate and optionally enforce a monthly cross-region budget. No surprise charges without explicit opt-in.
Nora: Spot eviction behavior: what's visible to users and what's retried automatically?
Vikram: Eviction flow: graceful drain window ~20s; if request interrupted client sees 502+`x-rdi-trace`. We automatically attempt one backend retry to fallback path for idempotent calls. We'll document recommended client retry logic.
Lina: Are there any new SLOs for cold-start in KUL? Customers want numbers.
Ethan: Target cold-start: node <= 100s in KUL, model warm-up medians: 7B ~ 20s, 13B ~ 35s, 70B ~ 70-90s. We'll publish median + p95 in Console telemetry for the pilot.
Vikram: Observability item: SRE to tag cold-start events with `region` + `model_variant` and emit `cold_start` metric. Also add `circuit_breaker` events to traces.
k8s-bot: CI job queued: autoscaler-v1.2-integration (ETA ~4m).
Nora: Action items: (1) @Ethan open API PR adding `residency_preference` enum + exact error/header text by Thu EOD, (2) @Lina coordinate Console toggle mock and projected egress UI by next sprint, (3) @Vikram add circuit-breaker header + telemetry tags and share instrumentation PR, (4) Support to draft a 1-paragraph public FAQ: "What if my workload loses spot nodes?"
Ethan: I'll open the PR and tag @eng-api.
Vikram: I'll add the telemetry tags and share dashboards.
k8s-bot: autoscaler-v1.2-integration passed. Canary ready.
Nora: Thanks all. I'll stitch the PR links and the FAQ draft into a single follow-up doc and post in #product-update. If you have urgent comments ping me directly.
